title: Anser

inlines.v: AN'SER, noun [Latin a goose.] 1. In zoology, the name of the goose, whether tame or wild. The domestic goose is the gray-lag or wild goose, domesticated. 2. In astronomy, a small star, in the milky way, between the swan and eagle.
